budget_title: Noise budget at the input, on the chip
budget: AFE: every device and resistor of the chip at the operating point its wiring gives the AFE (pad cells, straps, the bias ground offset; afe_chip_noise.py, AFE_IBIAS 3, Monte Carlo 30: 5.34 ± 0.07 nV rms, worst die 5.50 nV rms, 16.37 bit). The rest as budgeted on 10/26.
afe_noise: Harmonic-sum gain 287.3 V/V in the schematic, 284.8 V/V extracted, 283.2 V/V on the chip. The rise comes from the larger input-node capacitance, the input-path wiring, and on the chip the AFE's operating point there (bias ground offset, pad cells), typical, AFE_IBIAS 3.
checks_sub: DRC, LVS with two tools, pad-ring checks, wafer.space precheck, Magic and digital verification · 24–30 Oct 2026
checks: Precheck pre_20261029_r9: --slot 1x0p5 --cob as the shuttle specifies, latest image (20 Oct, PDK 792ef670). The pad-ring checks and the whole-chip LVS came in on 29 Oct, after the core's DVDD was found cut from its pads in r0–r7 (the core LVS, DRC and precheck had all passed); r7 fails them at DVDD, r9 passes.
rwire: Final layout: measured on the r9 chip (pex_rin.py), the same as r6 to the milliohm. T was set by the auto-routed gate wiring of the input pair before the D6 fixes. The per-side target for 16.50 bit (0.35 Ω) is for this chip wiring; the pad cells' own Metal2 (asig_5p0, two in parallel per electrode, 0.636 Ω per side, found on 27 Oct) comes on top: 1.27 / 1.33 Ω per side.
metrics: AFE: afe_top's extraction (unchanged since r6); gain from the ±0.5 mV chopped transient (200 µs). ADC: the schematic and the final column with C1 and C2 x1.25 (the r7 extraction of adc_top, unchanged since); loop at 20 kHz, 0.3 V pk, 100 µs, evaluated over 20–100 µs (80 frames); DAC1's even-order error from its own block's extraction (unchanged since r6). Behavioural SNDR: ELD 0.22 of a clock (reproduces the transistor loop), typical. The 10/23 column is that day's extraction and model (ELD 3/32).
